verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented bulk-action capability, such as multi-select scan, shred, forward or tag requests across many mail items in the UI, or batch endpoints in the API. The closest items are adjacent: automation rules handle incoming mail rule-by-rule rather than as an on-demand bulk action, and "deposit multiple checks together" and "bundle packages" are shipping and pricing consolidation options, not a general bulk-operations feature. The API is gated behind contact-to-request access with no public reference, so batch support there cannot be credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
